features.name: Country of Origin (COO)
features.description: Maps the Origin field (grower/farm/port) to its country using the mapping below.

features.name: Arrival Month
features.description: Calendar month name (January-December) extracted from the trip's actual arrival timestamp (falls back to segment-end time if arrival is missing) -- never the trip creation date -- for month-over-month trend reporting.

features.name: % In Spec
features.description: Share of monitored time the shipment stayed within the low-to-high temperature band, computed from the Time Below Low / Below Ideal / Above Ideal / Above High hour columns. Null wherever those hour columns are null or all zero.
